'''Preston Hunt''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Red 79 from Calgary, Ab. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He wrote for Echo Station 1138.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

He started playing around the release of [[Hoth Limited|Hoth]]. The 1998 Calgary Regional qualifier he helped organize was run by [[Ian Pownall]] (Red 77).<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
Red 79 reporting for duty! I first started playing Star Wars CCG around the time
that Hoth had just hit the shelves. Several of my friends had played it, and had
told me that it was a great game. Anyway, I had heard that the limited premiere
set was about to go out of print, and one day while walking through a game store,
I saw they were selling the starters for a decent price. I bought one, and from
the moment that I saw my first X-Wing, I was hooked. As part of Red Squadron,
I am involved in maintaining a close relationship with several of the game stores
in Calgary, and have had the privilege of running several of the big events that
Decipher has promoted, including The Shawn Valdez Charity Tournament, a Jabba's
Palace pre-release tournament, and upcoming Bespin and Beyond tournaments. Additionally,
I was partly responsible for organizing the 1998 Calgary Star Wars CCG Regional
qualifier that was run by Red 77, Ian Pownall this year. I run a tournament /
demo a month, keep all of my local players informed of big Decipher happenings,
and silently try to amass all of the Beru Stews in North America.

I have written several articles that can be found on the Web regarding why certain
cards were changed to benefit game play, and am a regular contributor to Echostation
1138.

Beyond Star Wars CCG, I spend my time renovating the house I just bought, and
playing with my son (and future SWCCG junkie), Timothy.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
